text: U.S. stocks edged higher pre-market as investors shrugged off massive announced AI equity issuances — including Anthropic’s likely $100B IPO, OpenAI’s expected offering, and META’s $100B secondary.  Markets awaited the Fed’s likely hawkish hold decision tomorrow and this week’s earnings from $GOOG, $MSFT, and $AMZN. Brent rose to $117, the 10-year yield eased to 4.98%, BTC held at $79.7K, and gold and silver declined. Tech names were generally higher, and $TSLA rose amid $SPCX merger speculation. S&P 2026 EPS estimates of $369 (+33% YoY) imply a 4.8% earnings yield, inverted versus Treasuries like the late-1990s. We remain cautious on $TSLA’, given its extreme valuation (2026 P/E of 220x vs +45% long-term earnings growth), negative forward earnings revisions, and the continued commoditization of autonomous driving technology.
